title: Display unit prices (large grocery retailers)
what: A prescribed grocery retailer must display a unit price for each grocery item for which it displays a selling price, unless the item is exempt.

laws.title: Competition and Consumer (Industry Codes—Unit Pricing) Regulations 2021

sources.title: Competition and Consumer (Industry Codes—Unit Pricing) Regulations 2021
sources.quote: 6 Display of unit prices (1) A prescribed grocery retailer must display a unit price for each grocery item sold by the retailer for which a selling price is displayed, unless the grocery item is exempt under clause 7, 8 or 9.
